Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [" To drowning, maybe! Not to the Embers! Morlund, it's over!", " Then you're going to die. Alone. Because we're not sticking around to fish out the corpse. We're through.", " Uh, I'm sorry. May I remind you. You got stuck inside and nearly drowned!", " What is this, what is happening here? What. Get over here. She's a stranger!", " You're a damned fool!", ' Partner?!', " Probably get a guest list of fifty, so we'd need… At least three dozen kegs. Brown ale maybe… no. For him. Scrappersap.", " Budgeting for Morlund's funeral, thanks to you! I was this close. We were going to move on, leave all this nonsense behind. Then you come along and you spark your wet-noodle idea!", " I've heard that before.", ' I work WITH Morlund. We got three equal claims in this venture. I saw one of his early shows, back when it was just him and his inventions. Works of flame, lights and shadows, all kinds of gizmos. Never seen the like. But the man is all spectacle, no sense. Bleeds shards like… like… You get the idea. Without me to handle the finances, his dreams would be sunk. More sunk. Wish we were back in the Claim! Plenty of normal shows to do without the salvage from this blasted place.', ' It was a good one. But sometimes a dream has to die.', ' Is going to get him killed.', " We'll have special seating, premium ale, the works! Morlund will do his light spectacle… thing. Stemmur will get their eyes a’sparklin' with his tales, and I'll be selling tickets. It's a nice thought, anyway.", " What? An Oseram can't be anything other than a delver, tinker, or drunkard? Okay sure, we are delvers too, but that is not our main source of income. Mostly… We go town to town. Putting on shows.", ' Tales and spectacle. Morlund\'s got the technical know-how. Builds all manner of inventions: whirligigs of light and sound, cannons that shoot fire and showers of sparks… and Stemmur-- "Keeps them enthralled with tales of adventure in the smoothest baritone." Yeah. That.', " Me? Who do you think handles the financials for the whole blasted thing? Those two might have the sparks, but do you think they know their way around shards? Hah! No, they don't.", ' I can delve too!', ' What do you think? Water rushed in. We ran. Then Morlund built that blasted thing. Nearly got himself drowned. Twice. You want the finer details of his stupidity, you go ask him.', " I'm always willing to engage in some commerce.", ' Do us a favor. Leave us all alone.', ' By that he means he owes me shards. 147 to be exact.', ' I thought we were finally going to get away from this place.', " We'll see.", ' I thought we were finally going to get away from this place.', " We'll see.", ' What? Are you crazy?', ' Very, um, heartwarming. but maybe we can just you know - Grab what we came here for and get out before any more of those things decide to show up?', ' How much did all this cost?', " There's another!", ' Like a carnival?', ' You mean call it something like… "Carnival Carnival"?']

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [' Another one down!', ' Not with those ribs.', " Erend. I hate to interrupt the romance, but I'm pretty banged up here.", ' Erend! By the forge!', ' What are you standing around for, then? Help me off this thing.', " That's our cue."]

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [" (offscreen) I'm running out of time, Elisabet. The land is dying. People are suffering. Soon, they'll starve. All because of a terraforming system that's spiraling out of control.", " And only I… Only I have your genetic code. It won't be long before we hit the point of no return. And then… Extinction. I've been searching for months for what I need. A backup of GAIA, the AI you designed to control the system. But every time I think I have a lead, it comes to nothing. And every night I have the same dream. I'm walking under a brilliant night sky, through a field of flowers. And when I arrive at the center… I see you, Elisabet. Waiting for me. Even though you've been dead for a thousand years. You're the closest person I've ever had to a mother.", ' And for a moment, I feel whole.', ' But it never lasts.', ' I’m always left alone.', " This world is your legacy, Elisabet. I won't let it slip away. The valley below is my only remaining lead. My last hope to find the backup. I'll do whatever it takes to get it. I promise.", ' Varl?!', ' You know I hate being called that stuff.', " I grew up an outcast, remember? I'm not much for parties.", " Okay. But if you're going to come with me, you'll need to be able to see what I see.", ' I give you another one later and show you how to back up your data.', " Information on the device. We've got a lot to cover. I'll have to explain everything as we go.", ' Since I was a little girl. Come on.', ' Shall we?', " All right. I got a couple of scrapes on the way here. We should find some medicinal plants, stock up. So it's time for your first lesson with the Focus.", ' The Focus helps you see the ones we need. Blech.', ' Yeah, well… at least they make you feel better. All right. We should keep going.', ' Yeah. Good idea.', ' (coughs) Some of the blight is… peeling off. Like dead skin. Is that how it spreads?', " Those ruins. That's where we need to go.", " The backup? Well it's an AI. It's… hard to explain. Think of it like… a set of instructions that can fix the world.", ' Yeah, I ran into some trouble on the way here and lost a lot of my gear. (coughs a few times) This stuff spreads fast.', ' Glinthawks.', ' Looks like they left a carcass behind.', ' A lot of arrows in that machine. Better take a closer look. Someone took down this machine recently.', " I don't know. We'd better craft some arrows of our own. There might be trouble up ahead.", ' All right. Now to craft some arrows. Done.', " Nothing a well-placed arrow can't knock free. Just have to target the lock.", " I don't know. The transmission the, uh, message found didn't say. Only that a backup might be here. We need to find a way in. So… what happened after I left Meridian?", " You were right about that. The blight's not just poisoning plants. It's killing animals, too.", " We're not going to let that happen.", ' A few supplies. Down this way.', ' (quietly) Get to the grass!', ' Me neither. Those dead machines have it on alert.', ' The Focus can help us. We can scan the machine before we make our move.', ' Give me a second… Okay. See how parts of it are glowing? Those are its weak spots.', ' Right. Okay concentrate.', ' It reads data on the machine.', ' Yeah. Kind of. So, after the fuss over me leaving, what did everyone else do?', ' Another ladder. Need to shoot off the lock.', " Yeah. Found my first one. When I fell into a ruin. Got the others from an old cache not long ago. It's good to have extras.", ' Far Zenith? I know they made some tech trades with Zero Dawn… but why would they have a backup of GAIA?', " Okay. I guess they weren't on great terms with Elisabet. Well, let's find a way in.", " I should be able to pry this open. There's climbing gear. Guess someone dropped in from above. Whoever left this here might've also shot those machines we found earlier.", " An entire camp… wiped out. They must've come here to delve for scrap.", ' Crashed right through the camp… and then through the wall. I should take a look at the rubble in that gap. Whatever came through here brought this down as it went out. If I can dislodge some of the debris. we might be able to squeeze through. Maybe I can find something to help in the camp.', ' And this gear pulls it back. Hmm.', ' …and pull it out. That could work. The Focus can help us search the camp and identify anything we can use to fix the tool. My Focus picked up a couple of things to check out.', ' Part of a machine. Could help fix the gears. Machine cable. Stronger than rope. All right. I think I have what I need to repair the tool… or maybe even make something better.', ' There - a Pullcaster. No to test it on the debris. Got it.', " That worked better than I thought. Well, it doesn't look like there's an easy way out of here. I should scan the area. We have to find a way to keep going. What's this?", " Hmm. Pulse didn't turn up much. I better scan. Guess we'll find out. Hmm. I might be able to get up there. Don't think I can reach that ladder from here.", ' Wow. That worked.', " Don't worry. I'll find you another way up. Okay, I gotta drop the ladder for Varl. There you go, Varl.", ' Well, yes - sort of. That ship, the Odyssey - it never made it to the other star. Something went wrong, and it blew up.', ' Is that why Elisabet gave them a backup of GAIA? For their colony?', " Yeah - reactivate. Let's see what else they had to say.", " Well, they were right about the world ending. They just didn't know how… yet.", " Yeah, well… didn't work out for them in the end. That Osvald guy mentioned a Data Center.", ' There. The backup… it should be stored in there.', " I guess we'll have to find a way around. Come on.", ' That did the tricks. Deeper into the creepy ruin we go.', " I don't know. Might've been what killed those Oseram. Keep your guard up.", " Up here. Careful. Don't want those things to cally in some friends from underground. Let's take them out quietly. You take the left one. I'll deal with the one on the right.", " I need to sneak up on it to take it out with my spear. Can't let it see me. I should scan it first. Check its patrol path. Got to get closer. And stay out of sight. I can throw a rock to distract it. Let it into a position where I can sneak up and strike. Just have to wait for the right moment. Got you!", " Nothing you and I can't handle.", " Got 'em all. I've been meaning to mention… I noticed you have a new look these days.", ' Good.', " Looks like this little guy got caught up in the blight. Couldn't escape.", " The Oseram must've used explosives against the machines.", " Looks like there was a barricade here. Machines must've broken through. Keep this for later.", ' Hmm. Might be able to disarm them. There. Managed to salvage some supplies. Dismantled it. And got more supplies.', ' Looks like another camp.', " Good idea. Hmm. I don't have the right supplies to craft a trap. But it looks like the Oseram shot off some machine parts. I might be able to scrounge up enough materials from them. I can use this. Okay. I should have what I need to craft a trap.", ' Machines ahead!', ' I better scan them.', " It's new to me. Let's see where its weak points are.", ' Set this here.', " Let's keep going, then.", " Let's hope it doesn't come this way.", " Yeah. And they're getting stronger. And more frequent.", " Yeah, but I can only do it if I find that backup. I think we're winding our way around to the Data Center. We'll need to cut through that big building on the right out there. Hey, Varl. There's data here. You scan it with your Focus. Hmm. This data mentions the tech that Far Zenith traded with Zero Dawn. But it doesn't explain how they got a backup.", " Looks like we've gotta climb up. Ah.", " Yeah. Guess we won't be going that way.", " Well, it is a thousand years old. Well it is a thousands. Looks like some kind of meeting room. That door on the other side's locked.", ' "Anzu"?', " I thought Elisabet sent the backup here… but she didn't. Far Zenith stole GAIA.", " It's okay Varl. We look alike because… were the exact same. Genetically identical.", " Because I wasn't born, I was made… by a machine. It's why I'm motherless. Why I was cast out as an infant.", " Remember when I said the backup is like a set of instructions? It's more than that. It's called GAIA. And for a long time, she cared for the world, until she had to destroy herself. So she made me to bring her back. I'm the only one who can. And this place is my last hope.", " Yes. But she's not the Goddess, Varl. There isn't one.", " (sighs) I've had a lot of time to figure this out. And you will, too, with the Focus. But for now… The report said they were going to store the stolen copy of GAIA in the Data Center. So that's where we have to go. Okay?", ' A weapon. Thanks, Varl. We should keep moving.', " Down here. I think we're almost back outside.", " And it's heading in the same direction we're going. Great. Another one of those machines. I could try out that new weapon on it.", " I can do more damage to it while it's brittle! Gotcha!", " More of the Oseram delvers. And a lot of acid. That big machine must've attacked as they tried to escape.", ' Looks like we can cross over here.', ' Yeah. All those places I’ve been these last few months? There were supposed to be more backups, but a thousand years ago a guy named Ted Faro purged them all.', ' No. He was worse.', ' (finds a corpse) More Oseram. Machines tore right through them.', ' We can tag them in the Focus to keep track of them. Okay. Now how to get out of here?', " What's in here?", ' So, tell me something. Sona was really okay with you not going back to the Sacred Lands?', " Is she ever pleased? I don't think I've seen her smile.", " There's no way to slip past them… and they're too tough to fight head-on.", " That would take weeks. And we don't have that kind of time. Maybe all we need is that shuttle to fall.", " I'll figure it out. Just wait here.", ' Trust me.', ' Just need to get over to the shuttle to figure out how to make it fall into the basin.', " If I can make it to that tower, I should be able to find a way across to the shuttle. There. That ladder can get me up the tower. Okay. There's a rail up there. I think I can reach it if I launch myself off that grapple point. Got it! Well, that sounds good. Storm's getting bad. Made it. Easy! That was close. One rickety tower down. On to the next. I won't be able to make that jump. But there is a cable here. Maybe I can ride it to the other side. Uh… Whoa! Well nowhere to go but up. This place is barely holding together. Looks like there are massive clamps holding the shuttle in place. I'll bet there's a control console nearby. If I can release the clamps, the shuttle should fall right into the basin. Great. More machines in my way. Control console might be in there. Okay. Time to crush those machines down below.", " The shuttle's caught up in those cables. I'm gonna have to climb the tower to find a way to disconnect them. Now how to get up the tower? Scanning with my Focus could help here. Down it goes. I've got to climb closer to the shuttle to detach the cables. Okay, that creaking doesn't sound good. This should be the right spot. There. That connector's holding the cables together. It should break if I shoot it. One down. Now I just need to climb higher and detach the second set of cables. Scaling an ancient, rickety tower with killer machines waiting down below. Maybe Varl was right. But no turning back now. Almost there. There's the other connector.", ' Oh, shit! Shit!', ' Not going anywhere, are you?', " Guess we're finishing this the hard way. I need to take this thing down to get to the Data Center should scan for weak spots. Okay. Where's the weak spot? That sac's full of acid should target it first. Whoa! Still got some fight left in you. Ha ha! Try spitting at me now! There! Those canisters are exposed now. I should aim for them! Damn it, it broke free! Gotta take this thing down fast! A trap, maybe? Frost ammo? Or my Focus might find something I can use around here.", " Let's see what this can do. How do you like that?", " It’s dead. Finally. The Data Center should be straight ahead. I guess Varl's gonna have to find another way there. Once I get the backup, I can reboot GAIA. Fix the system, heal the blight. Restore Elisabet's dream. But is it still there?", " Okay. I should find the server room. I'm close. I have to be. Please be here. It's here!", ' Hi…!', ' Elisabet…?', " (annoyed) There is no Goddess! I told you that already. That's not GAIA, it's not what I'm looking for - it's nothing but a fake!", " Varl. I'm sorry.", " The thing is, there's going to be more of that. I'm out of leads, Varl, but I have to keep searching, and fast. And whatever risks I have to take, I will. And it doesn't make sense to have someone with me. Someone who might get hurt. This is on me, Varl. Nobody else.", " He's gone, Varl. I haven't heard from him since the battle against HADES.", " Okay. I guess it's worth a shot.", " Actually, I've got a better idea.", ' Not yet.', " I don't know. The Spire's supposed to send out signals - messages - for the terraforming system.", ' I was sure I cut the connection to that thing. Wait here while I check it out.', ' What?', ' What the--?', " No. He wouldn't. He couldn't… Something was transmitted from the top of the Spire. Guess I have to find a way up there.", " Uh… is that a statue of me? That's new.", ' Not done yet But it definitely looks like the ord transmitted something into the Spire.', " I guess I should be flattered by the statue. It feels wrong, especially when my job's only half done.", ' Looks like a memorial. “Honoring those who fell in the Battle of the Alight.” Lots of brave people defended this place from HADES.', ' Machine carcasses. Remnants from the Battle of the Alight.', " We were almost overrun by the machines HADES controlled But we pushed through. There we go. Now how to cross over to the Spire? Got it. Should be able to get up there now. I thought Sylens was helping me when he gave me his lance. But it looks like he tricked me. It transmitted something through the Spire. Did he save HADES? Why would he do that? Well it can figure out where he sent it. I can track him down. Hopefully the transmission node at the top will tell me. Looks like this panel's ajar. Can I go up through the inside? An elevator? Let's see.", ' My lucky day.', ' The whole thing is opening up! Wonder what the Carja will make of this.', " There's the node.", ' Somewhere to the far west. Bastard.', ' You rigged the lance to steal HADES? How could you be so reckless?', " If you knew, why didn't you just tell me?", " Oh, I'll come find you, all right.", " (sighs) There's no other choice.", " Better let Varl and Marad know what I've found.", " HADES… The danger didn't end here. It went into the Forbidden West, and I have to follow.", ' Avad, this is all very kind, but I-- Uthid. Vanasha!', " It's beautiful.", ' I need to attach the Master Override to my new spear should be a workbench around here I can use.', " You were right. I'm sorry, Avad. It's good to see you, but I can't stay long.", " Meridian's still in danger - but it's bigger than that. To put things right, I have to go west. Tenakth territory.", ' When you say “years of hostility” I assume you mean the Red Raids?', " I wouldn't ask if I didn't need to know.", ' What makes this coming Embassy so special?', " Soldier? Don't you mean raider?", ' Your cousin Fashav - how long has he been a Tenakth captive?', ' If I see him, I will. How did you get the Tenakth to talk again after the war?', ' Ha. The Tenakth like tiaras?', ' Itamen looks happy.', " Wouldn't the crown go to a son of yours first?", ' You make it sound easy. I need to get going.', " (clever answer) Avad, the situation calls for a… higher perspective. The threat I'm facing endangers not just Meridian but a lot of other places, too. A lot of innocent people. What happens between us. It's not important. At least, not yet.", ' Well… time to head west.', " You said it fine, Itamen. And you're welcome.", ' Something like that. But when I come back, I could give you a few tips. It would be an honor.', " That's part of the Deathbringer we defeated. This machine was the last line of defense for HADES. It dragged the orb up here and then nearly killed me. But as just a piece of scrap now. There. A workbench.", ' Uthid, Nanasha. Thanks for being here.', " You both look like you're doing well.", ' And how about you, Vanasha?', ' I never pictured you as a nanny. Itamen must be special.', ' We were talking about Itamen?', " It's been months since I was in Sunfall. What's become of the Shadow Carja?", ' Okay. Master Override installed. Plus something new, to store up and release energy - a "Resonator." Should help in a fight.', " I'd better get going. And if I'm headed west, it sounds like I'll need right of passage from the Tenakth, as you said. Where exactly is this Embassy going to be held?", ' Actually, it might be better to rest here tonight, head out in the morning.', ' Is that how I get to Barren Light?', ' And why is that?', ' I can handle machines.', " Look. I didn't come all this way just to stand around and wait. I'll crank that car down myself if I have to.", ' I see smoke. But not a lot of activity.', ' What sort of machines are causing the trouble?', ' No hunters to kill them?', " Yeah, well. I'm just passing through. Got an Embassy to attend.", ' What are you talking about?', ' Who is that?', ' Great.', ' I came here for the Embassy at Barren Light. Way I hear it, so did you.', " Fine. Captain's a friend of mine, you know. (to Joruf) Where is Erend? Wouldn't mind talking to someone a little more action, a little less scroll.", ' Hey! Shh. Down the valley, then?', " Okay hear there's a work stoppage. Any way to upgrade my gear?", " Thanks. I'll find Erend and I'll bring him back.", " Hey! Where do you think you're going?", " Sorry, operator's under strict orders. No passengers till the whistle blows, right?", ' Joruf, would you kindly escort Studious to Chainscrape and wait for me there?', ' I will find Erend and I will help clear a path. But after that no more excuses. Barren Light. Embassy.', ' It will be. Trust me.', ' I got to find Erend, but it might be good to hit Chainscrape first and upgrade my bow.', " Those machines must've torn through this camp. This valley definitely isn't safe.", " I think I can climb up this cliff. I wonder if there's anything interesting at the top?", " An old Carja watchtower. I wonder what's inside? Okay. Almost there.", ' Some kind of device. The metal reflects the sun… to send a signal?', " Looks like some kind of lens. Guess I'll keep it for later.", ' I can almost see the entire valley up here. No wonder the Carja built this watchtower.', ' Must be Chainscrape. Joluf said I would get my bow upgraded in there. Might be able to tinker with my other gear, too.', ' If I find where these machines are made I might learn how to override them.', " It's a dead machine. It must be a Bristleback. Maybe Erend took it down? Bristlebacks must've got these Oseram. hope Erend and the other Vanguard are okay. Ground's soaked with acid. Did the Bristlebacks do this?", " Open up guys. Joruf's orders.", ' Petra?', ' Yeah, I heard. Machines, work stoppage.', ' Ulvund?', ' Yeah.', " Uh, Petra, Petra… I'm just passing through. I'm headed west.", " There's an Embassy at Barren Light that need to make happen. And then I keep moving.", ' Well this Ulvund guy sounds like trouble. Maybe Petra could use some support. But first things first. I need to find that workbench and upgrade my bow.', ' Shop looks closed.', ' Can still use the workbench?', ' This should be useful. Now just need to find Erend and help him clear the Bristlebacks.', " Sounds like you're serving up some impressive provisions here.", ' I think you have me confused with someone else.', ' No.', ' Some of your… food?', " Are Ulvund's people causing you problems?", ' And if you refuse?', ' How did you end up in Chainscrape?', " Your last customer mentioned your cooking really kept him going out in the wild. Where I'm headed, I could use some of that.", ' But?', ' What do you need?', " Thanks, Milduf. I'll keep an eye out.", " And don't let anyone push you around, okay?", ' What happened to you?', ' What mine?', ' How about you slow down and take me through it? You mentioned you were injured in a cave-in.', " And you're afraid Korvend and the others might not be as lucky if it happens again?", " How come Ulvund's in charge? Don't these mines belong to the Carja?", " Who's Korvend?", ' Sounds like a good guy.', " I could check in on your crew if I'm in the area.", ' (clear her throat) Hi.', ' We might. Later.', ' (sighs) Maybe.', " Once I've dealt with any problems around here that need my… Savior-ly attention.", " Not so fast. You don't seem to have a high opinion of the magistrate.", ' How noble of you.', ' And where is this hammer now?', ' You ordered the work stoppage?', ' “Fair deal” - you mean your concession decree.', ' Right. And just how much would be your share?', " If Chainscrape is on Carja land, shouldn't a Carja be in charge? Who appointed you?", ' So you have no real authority, then. People only follow you because you say so. Loudly.', ' You said you founded Chainscrape? Somehow, I doubt that.', " Oh, so you're not just standing around and profiting off everyone else?", " Where's the whistle?", " I'm going to clear out the Bristlebacks. And when I'm done this valley is going to get moving.", ' Just be ready to blow the whistle.', " Better see what that Carja magistrate wanted. I bet he's in the tavern.", ' You wanted to speak to me?', ' Who?', " So to find The Enduring, I should look for these training pits if I'm ever out that way.", ' Who would I be fighting, exactly? You?', ' I might be.', " Was that a Tripwire? Whole area's rigged with them.", " It's always something. Hold tight! I'll see what can do!", ' Spotted. Gotta move.', " Stunned - got an opening! That's the last one.", ' So the Vanguards came through here?', ' So the Vanguard went south.', ' I see.', ' Workmanship looks solid enough.', ' Did something happen in Chainscrape?', ' Let me guess: Ulvund.', ' Cable car operator told me the Bristlebacks just appeared yesterday. Do you know anything about them?', ' Anything about the Bristlebacks?', ' I should get going. Thanks for the Tripcaster.', ' Maybe. After I get things under control.', ' So Erend headed south. Should be able to pick up his tracks with my Focus.', " There's tracks… headed up the hill. Erend's? My Focus can help me follow them. Let's see where this leads.", " Sounds like someone's putting up a fight.", ' Erend!', " Stay where you are! I'll handle the rest!", " Those Bristlebacks have Acid canisters on their backs. It should trigger a chain reaction if I hit them with Acid Arrows. Machine's tough. Acid's no use here.", ' Well, you did the hard part just took care of the stragglers. How bad is it?', " I need the Embassy to happen. So I can head west. Erend, what I did at the Spire… what we did… it didn't end the threat. It just slowed it down There's still more to do.", " (sighs) Erend, I need the Embassy now. I can't wait for you to heal.", " Actually… even if you weren't hurt, what have to do… it's better if I do it alone.", " Oh, I know him. I'll clear the valley of Bristlebacks, then send Vuadis to Barren Light. I'll catch up with you there.", " I'm sorry?", ' Where is this coming from?', ' It sounds like something.', ' Erend, I left when I did, how did, for a reason. A good one.', ' Listen to me. Life on Earth is in danger and only I can save it.', " Exactly what I just said. Everything living is going to die unless I… …fix a piece of technology created by the Old Ones. And time's running out.", ' Maybe I should go with you to Barren Light.', " That doesn't sound good.", " I can't override that machine. But I could learn, if there's a Cauldron out here.", " It's a run from the Old World. Bet I could find something interesting inside. Okay. What do we have in here?", " It'll be slow going if I use Acid on it.", ' Glad I can help.', " Let's do it.", ' Just Aloy is fine.', " You're Vanguard.", ' I should probably get going.', " I'll make sure to roll out of their way.", ' Thanks.', " Think that metal tower's giving off the signal I could head over there, check it out.", " An image from the Old World. Looks like some kind of building in front of sheer cuffs. The image is incomplete… but maybe if ime it up exactly with where it was taken my Focus can fill in the rest. There's the quarry Thurlis mentioned. And it's full of Bristlebacks.", ' One less machine.', " Incoming! Another one down. One less machine. I think I'm out of range of the Vista Point. I gotta try again.", ' Another one down. Shocked and locked!', " There. Quarry's safe.", ' Is everyone okay?', " Well at least it's quiet now.", ' You need the whistle to get back to work?', ' Ulvund holds that much power?', ' What are you and your crew working on?', " I'm not sure. At least not yet. I need to get going. Stay safe.", " I think I've cleared out most of the Bristlebacks. Chainscrape can get back to work now. I'll go give Ulvund the good news. Vuadis, too. Then maybe this Embassy can finally happen.", " I could look around with my Focus, try to match the Vista Point image. It looks like the building in the image might’ve been near a river. Maybe there used to be a bridge nearby? The ruins of a bridge. Maybe it's the same one from the image? I could try to line it up around here. There it is! Huh. Completing the image unlocked a data file. It looks like these Vista Points were made by… Miriam Technologies. That was Elisabet’s company. I wonder if I can find more of them out in the wilds.", " It's a ruin from the Old World. Bet I could find something interesting inside. Okay. What do we have in here? Looks like this door needs some kind of key module. Maybe there's one in the ruins. Some data survived. There's a code for the locked door in this data. But I still need to find a key module. A crate. This should be useful. It's not hooking on to that. Okay. Got to find a key for the door. There's more of the ruin down here. Where to now? Whoa! Well I can't reach the ledge above now. Guess I'll have to find another way up. There. A little more light down here. Down it goes. Okay. Now where doces lead? Ah-ha. A key module. An Old World relic. How do I get in there to get it? You guys - take the high ground in case we need covering fire.", ' One more thing. Open up the channel to Beta, audio only.', " We're here, and we're coming for you. You know what to do, right?", ' We will. See you soon.', " Let's go.", ' Company. Follow my lead.', ' I should hit it with Plasma. Gotcha!', " I think you're right.", ' Yeah.', " Let's climb up to it.", ' Keep me posted!', " Don't worry, I'll protect you.", " There's a lot of dead machines on this island.", ' Another Specter. It’s fallen! Thanks for the assist.', ' Tired yet?', " We're through.", ' That Stormbird carcass should get us over the gap.', ' Oh, yeah. Good times.', " Could hit it with Acid. (shooting with a heavy gun) Gave all it got. I think that's all of them - here, at least. Let's push on.", " A little. Here. Up this rock. We're going to have to climb around this corner.", ' Going as fast as we can. You all right?', " More than we want to fight at once that's for sure.", ' Looks like the others have things under control. Come on. Up this slab.', ' Do it - blow the regulator.', " (via Focus) Alva and Kotallo did their job. Now it's Beta's turn.", ' Our army.', " And now it can crank out machines to its heart's content. Come on. Let's get to the launch tower before this whole place becomes a warzone.", " We grabbed it once we'll get it again.", ' What is it?', ' That big rock might give us a bridge to get up and through.', ' Plasma will do a lot of damage here.', ' I think they can handle it.', ' This way.', ' And now to the left.', " Good work, everyone. Let's go.", ' Keep at it. We’re almost to the tower.', ' Sylens - Zeniths inbound. Can we drop their shields, please?', ' I gotta get to the top of the tower and free Beta.', ' Just do the best you can! Okay, an elevator. Promising.', " Trust me, you're gonna wish you had one.", " Give it a rest first. Till I get my stamina back. Felt that didn't ya?", " Not much without your shield are ya? Take that! Still in this fight. He’s almost down! Oh, don't like that do ya?", ' You okay?', ' Looks like the machines and Specters have almost wiped each other out. What was that?', ' Including the lift?', ' Erend, is everyone all right down there?', ' What about the Zeniths?', ' Yeah. Thanks. I guess only Tilda and Gerard are left, then.', " I'm almost there. This is it. End of the line.", ' Look - "escape vectors." Alva tried to warn me about this. The Zeniths aren\'t planning to stay here.', " Earth isn't a new home for them. It's a way station. They're on the run.", " And you've been lying. Nemesis - what is it?", ' And it destroyed your colony?', ' But why?', ' With GAIA. So you can build yourself a new world.', ' What? No.', " You can't force me, Tilda. Your shield is gone.", ' (to Beta) Take cover! Get to the door!', " I've heard that before.", " I gotta get through all that armor before I can do some damage. I better scan that thing first. I bet that weapon has ammo left. I could use it! Ha! Those gold plates are vulnerable! That thing's fast. I need to get my stamina back first. You're not taking me, Tilda! Ah, it's quick! Well that did something! Damn, need more! Armor's off! A few more hits! Elemental ammo's making a dent in those gold plates!", " It's over. Why couldn't you just let me choose?", " So you've known all along.", " And you couldn't just tell me?", " You're going to just take off and abandon everything?", ' Stay. Help me fight that thing.', ' Goodbye, Sylens.', ' As far away as anyone can go.', " You're staying?", " (in her room) There's another battle ahead, Elisabet… …very different than the one you fought. It's not about the distant hope of creating a new world… …it's about preserving the one we have. My friends have a new mission to spread the word and ask for help. They've taken it in stride, I think it's because they've always known what I've only just started to understand. That the people of this world have the strength to fight any battle… the ingenuity to solve any problem… …the courage to overcome any obstacle… And the resilience to rise after any setback. As for me - I can't say I'm not afraid. What lies ahead will be harder than anything we've faced before. But I know I can put the fear aside. Because for the first time in my life… …I feel like I'm not alone."]

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [' I submit. Do as you will.', ' I am of the chosen people, the Quen. The Ancestors left the power of the focus to us alone - the eye that reveals the Legacy.', ' The Legacy. The truth. It is in the darkness and the lost places, among the ancient ashes and the bones of the before, that it lies waiting. As a Diviner, it is my task to seek it out… for the good of my people.', ' Alva. Second Diviner of the Eastern Expedition.', " Our lands lie across the Great Ocean. We haven't been here before.", " Our homeland has been ravaged by freakish weather - terrible storms and blistering droughts. The crops are failing. The people are starving. When we looked for answers, it was proposed that if we had the courage to cross the ocean to Legacy's Landfall… then we might earn the knowledge we need to save our people. But so far, that knowledge has eluded us.", ' No. Landfall is where we arrived. To the west, in the shadows of the Sunken City, by the broken bridge.', " Yes. You're well-versed in the Legacy. It was a place of great importance to our Ancestors. We had hoped to learn their secrets there, but so far that door remains closed. Even so, the data we discovered there has led us to this place. It might be our last chance.", ' Yes. If the Ancestors will be generous to us once more.', ' Yes. Thirteen Diviners have possessed this one since it was discovered among the ruins in our homeland.', ' We each have our role to play. No, it is the Diviners purpose to seek out the Legacy. Interpret the wisdom of our Ancestors for the good of all. And to keep it safe. Not even the Imperial family And certainly not soldiers.', " At Landfall, a small group. Back at home, a few dozen more. That's a guess. Only the Overseers know for sure, and I am not of their rank.", ' Yes - all that is not Lost, or Forbidden.', ' All that we are capable of reading, and that which is permitted.', ' The greatest secrets are the ones that improve the lives of many. How to tend our crops, how to hold flood waters back, or even cross the ocean.', ' That is what I seek here. Technology that can help my people back home.', ' It is the duty of the Quen to seek out the Legacy… and defend it from the ignorant and envious. Not that you seem ignorant. But back home, other tribes only mean us harm. And we were told the same was true here.', ' The Legacy is truth. But, we have been known to misinterpret it. I hope time and the wisdom of our Ancestors will guide us down the correct path.', ' No. But I did find something like looks like a map. But it was unreadable - Lost.', ' There.', ' I\'ve been through all of them. Look in the "gh/facility" section. Like I said. A Lost file.', ' Share them?', ' You can see what is Lost… and Forbidden.', " But you can't get there. We've been here for a week, trying to get deeper into the complex. The way has been blocked by rubble.", " I believe these consoles were meant to be operated in unison, but I'm not sure.", ' Following your lead. The Ancestors have shown us the way.', ' You want me to come with you?', ' This place is a maze.', " Lead the way. I can't believe you actually got us in. I was dreading having to stay here any longer with those soldiers. The way they slaughtered the barbarians that approached the site… it was like they enjoyed it. Most of my people aren't like that. I promise.", " Okay. Well, that was loud. There has to be a way out of here. What's that thing in the wall?", " A dead end. Maybe we should try another path. We haven't tried that smaller tunnel over there.", " I'll be glad to get back above ground.", ' They fly to and from the complex several times a day. Only the Ancestors know why.', ' Of course. How else could they be “ancestors”?', ' We can fight them. Or try to sneak past. Your call.', " I've never seen anyone fight machines like you do.", " I'm right behind you. Maybe we can get through that hatch on the ground. It looks like the one we used at the first station. There's consoles up here, too!", ' Um, Aloy, would… would you mind warning me next time you decide to, uh, blow up a wall?', ' That looks like some sort of conveyor rig… You think you can move it over to me?', ' Exactly! Hold it there! Let me just-- I jumped on top!', " That's good. Jumping over. Made it! I'm at the console. Wait… there's data here. A lot. But it's blocked. Something's restricting access. If I can't get past it, my mission here is doomed.", " Right. We need to open the hatch. Let's see, Okay. I'm unlocking a storage unit. There should be a power cell inside. Then you need to find a way into the generator room.", ' Okay. That brought power back to the doors. You can reach me now.', ' Okay. We need to operate both consoles simultaneously to open the hatch.', ' Ready when you are!', ' What is this…?', ' What did we just see?', ' The time of ashes. But most of the data about that is Lost. Or Forbidden.', " But even if I believe you, my people won't. I need to bring something back.", " I'm not sure I understand. But, every secret makes its own maze. A Diviner must persevere. Go on. I'll follow.", ' Another maze. But the road to truth is never a straight line. So, the Metal Flowers… what the data referred to as "Adamantine Wreaths…" They were supposed to stop the destruction that caused the time of ashes?', ' So, I never asked… are you from around here?', " We've both traveled a long way, then.", " Let's hope it holds the answers we seek.", ' It can turn invisible??', ' Yes.', ' That was amazing! Terrifying. But amazing.', " We shouldn't linger here. There might be more machines.", " I trust your Focus will see what mine cannot. Oh. That's interesting.", " The fourth Test Station… Willow. It looks like it's underwater.", ' I must have faith. I walk with the Ancestors. We shall find what we seek.', ' So, all their efforts were in vain. They ran out time.', " There's one back at our camp. The map showed a path leading back there past the next room.", ' Right behind you.', " Uh…right. Easy. Uh… Made it! But we'd better make haste. After we encountered barbarians, our Lieutenant called for reinforcements. They could be here any time.", ' Now what?', " The vines. They're falling apart.", ' The Data Core Looks intact.', " What did you do? I've never seen my Focus glitch like that.", " Hold your fire! By the word of the Ancestors, you must stop! Come. Look at who you've fired on!", ' Only those who fired blindly. She is no barbarian. She gave me the data we need. Come, look at her.', " Can't you see? Elisabet Sobeck stands before you! An Ancestor reborn!", " It is we who follow their word, commander. Not the other way around. My apologies, Dr. Sobeck. Our people's faith is strong, but there are those who are not as familiar with the Legacy as they should be.", " I can't talk long. They will have many questions.", ' Please. I must know. What you said before, about working towards the same goal? How long will it take?', " Then you are my family's best hope. Let nothing get in your way. You have opened my eyes to many things. And for that. I thank you. But now you must go.", " Soon we return to Legacy's Landfall. It might be dangerous for you to go there.", ' We made Landfall on the northeast edge of the Sunken City. The currents around the archipelago are vicious, and the only approach is from the south, and it is guarded. Only attempt to go there if you must.', " Please. Go. If you attempt to stay here any longer they may want to take you with us and that won't go well, for anyone.", ' Aloy! Over here!', ' You got rid of that machine! But what are you doing here?', " And you're going to help us get in?", " If I may? Faro, great as he was, did not build his palace alone. We know this from scraps of data we found, the ones that pointed to this location. And we found evidence of passages below. Maybe they were built to aid construction. Or, for servants. We can't reach them - the way is flooded and they're too far underwater. But...", ' Yeah, I tried to warn you.', " I'll explain everything if we survive long enough!", " Where's Overseer Bohai?", " I'm sorry, Ceo. I don't know. My Focus can't read the data here.", ' Really? Could he... still be alive?', " Good idea. It's worked before.", " There's so much smoke! The whole place is shaking! Run! I can barely breathe. More soldiers up ahead!", ' Ugh. Not a pleasant way to die.', " He's... gone. I guess you could say he gave his life to help us attain the secrets of Thebes.", ' What? No. No!', ' I thought he was going to have us killed. And instead, I get to join you!', " A Diviner must follow the truth, wherever it leads. I'll see you there.", ' Aloy!', " You're right. I also owe you an explanation for everything that happened, at Landfall.", " It's been fascinating. So much better than the version the Quen have! What would have taken me years to sort through, like the database you helped me recover… ...with this, I've been able to establish search parameters to speed up the process. This could revolutionize how Diviners analyze the Legacy! That is whatever part of it the Overseers would actually let us study.", " A Diviner has never had this sort of unsupervised access to archives such as this. And knowing you, I suspect there is much that would normally be Forbidden held within them. But I was sent here to help you. I would be remiss to ignore any truth laid before me. Maybe it'll help the Quen find their way back to the path of truth.", " The Zenith who tried to kill you? He is known to the Quen as The Protector. Combing through data related to his work led us to breakthroughs related to weapons and military tactics. Knowledge our rulers used to conquer and expand. To become the Empire we are today. That's why he's one of our most revered Ancestors. But based on your encounter with him, it appears he's even more ruthless than we ever imagined. Yet another distorted interpretation in the Legacy.", ' If only the Overseers back home would do the same.', " I'm afraid I don't know anything about them. Whatever Legacy they left behind, the Diviners haven't recovered.", " It's funny, because one of your friends is, well, another you. Not that you are the same person, at all. I mean--you are-- as in-- you're both genetically Elisabet Sobeck-- But even so, you're different.", " Oh. Yeah. Of course. They've all been extremely welcoming. And they share the knowledge they learn on their focuses with each other freely. It's refreshing. Back home, Diviners can only share data with the permission from the Overseers.", ' You are not wrong.', " Right. I'll start at the beginning with the Ceo. He was an Imperial - the Emperor's nephew, in fact. As such, he sponsored many Diviners to search the Legacy for anything that might help the tribe. And himself. He took a special interest in anything related to Ted Faro, whom we consider the greatest of the Ancestors.", " l know better now, of course. Anyway, the Diviners discovered that Faro spent a great deal of time in San Francisco. In fact, many of the most important Ancestors did. So the Emperor's nephew convinced him that an expedition across the ocean might solve our most pressing problems. If only we could find the right data in this fabled city. If only we could find the right data in this fabled city… ...perhaps we could roll back the floods and storms that threatened our people. The Emperor declared that all the tribe's resources be poured into this endeavor. Dozens of ships were built. Scouting missions were dispatched. And the Emperor's nephew was named Ceo, one who wields the Legacy for the good of the Empire. The living embodiment of Ted Faro, the Renewer. It may seem strange now, but for a time, he carried all of our hopes. We really believed he would save us. We had no idea just how perilous the journey would be.", ' We lost most of our ships to hurricanes, and scores of soldiers perished to hunger and disease. And that was before we even hit the coast. Once we landed, machines ripped our patrols apart. And we struggled to replenish our rations. There were bright spots, to be sure. We found Thebes and the Greenhouse. But nothing improved the Ceo\'s mood as his dreams of saving the tribe were slowly dashed. He became more and more obsessed with Thebes and what lay behind its door… and more and more convinced that the title of Ceo was no mere honorific. You heard him. Spouting nonsense about Faro\'s "essence" and some kind of “becoming.” We knew these weren\'t the words of a sane man. But he was quick to put any who spoke out in front of a firing squad.', " The Quen are wrong about many things when it comes to the Legacy. I can see that now. But what the Ceo “became” was a complete perversion of what principled Diviners stand for - the pursuit of truth. I'm sorry you had to endure his madness. I'm just glad it's over. For everyone.", " Diviners are meant to seek out the truth in the Legacy. And many Imperials sponsor them in the hopes they'll find something the Empire can put to use, thus gaining favor with the Emperor. But the Board of Overseers claims certain truths are… detrimental to the stability of the Empire. Like discovering one of our revered Ancestors ended the world. That is why Diviners are only allowed to access segments of the Legacy. Only Overseers can view it all. It ensures that any heretical data can be contained and retrieved before it can spread.", ' I never had the courage to ask.', ' Yes and no. The Ancestors are the greatest of the Old Ones. Those whose Legacy taught us agriculture, medicine, warfare, leadership. and patronage of the science and arts.', " Right. Well… any Old One who has made minor contributions or worked extensively under one of the Ancestors is called an Assistant. That's how we thought of Sobeck. Until we met you. Our limited access to data past the late 2040s has obviously… misinformed our view of the past.", ' Her name is Elika. Our parents are commoners. Peasants, really. When I passed the Divination exams they were so proud. It brought honor to our family and increased rations. Only Elika begged me not to leave for the Research Academy.', " Elika knew that once you enter you're not allowed to leave or see anyone - not even your family. Unless you can get special permission and an escort by an Overseer.", " Like the focuses we keep, Diviners are few in number and the Empire is… well, fearful that outsiders will try to steal our knowledge. Last time I was allowed to see my family was just before our voyage here. Because of my position, I was able to get them refuge from the floods within the capital. But if our crops don't recover soon, they'll starve to death along with everyone else.", ' All I need is to help you succeed in your mission. The plan GAIA told me about, to capture HEPHAESTUS… It will help set things right?', ' Then I will do whatever I can. I promise.', ' Not at all. I was just studying the pulse generator schematics. The ones GAIA and Beta built The craftsmanship is remarkable. Is everything all right? It sounded like there was an... issue with Beta, and the mission?', " All of it! I have so much to study up on. Years, actually. I'm particularly interested in the Odyssey. In fact, we theorized some of them had settled on it. But Sirius is WAY farther than that. And we thought journeying across the ocean would be the feat of a lifetime! The sheer calculations needed for space travel! It's overwhelming to think about!", " A little bit. But… I did hear her singing with Varl not too long ago. I don't think they noticed. Zo seemed so... free when she did it. Like every emotion she had was taking flight in song. And she looked happier because of it. I felt so dull and nervous in comparison.", ' Maybe.', " You have nothing to worry about. GAIA's explained your plan in detail. As expected from such an efficient AI. I've even received some very, um... succinct combat advice from Kotallo. You know... in case the Zeniths show up.", ' He, uh, told me to run.', " It is. Part of me's curious to know who else besides Erik Visser might be among them. Maybe Nikhita Arand? We call her The Spark. The Legacy tells us she brought unlimited energy to the Old Ones. Or Song Jiao, whom we call The Healer. It is said she found new ways to extend the Ancestors' lifespans. But my curiosity fades when I think of how different our view of Visser was compared to the reality that you experienced. Perhaps it is better not to know.", " Yes! So, as I was sifting through data from the Greenhouse, I found references to an Old World system back in the Great Delta. It's called Leviathan. My people discovered it decades ago - a sprawling network of river gates and a labyrinth of underground tunnels. The Legacy revealed that the Old Ones used it to control flooding… but we've never gotten it to work. The whole thing is shut down. But the data from the Greenhouse mentions the research facility where Leviathan was created. It's in San Francisco.", " No. Leviathan was a project by Eileen Sasaki, another Ancestor… so the Legacy tells us, anyway. If we can acquire that data, we might be able to fix the system back in the Great Delta. Every year, my sister gets terrified when the long rains begin. With Leviathan, maybe she won't have to be.", " That's the thing. The data doesn't say where, exactly. But one of our Diviners has been exploring the ruins. He might know. Would you come with me? I have a feeling that wherever this facility is, well… You're much better at fighting machines than I am.", ' Thank you, Aloy.', ' May your path lead to truth.', ' I appreciate it.', " (via Focus) That means they're working. I'm in position and mine is, too.", ' Not to mention the Zeniths. What can we even do - throw ourselves at their base?', " My studies are a good distraction, especially after Cauldron GEMINI. Varl. Beta. GAIA. Gone. And that's just the beginning. The Zeniths want to rob us of our future, too.", " Yes! I've been studying up on them. The most fascinating one thus far has been the Tenakth. An entire culture based on the holograms of an ancient museum… There's much they've misinterpreted… not unlike the Quen. But still, there's a nobility to what they've become. They're honorable. And fearless.", " Varl's loss is heavy on everyone's mind. I didn't know him well, but I can see how much he meant to the others. Zo and Erend seem to have taken to it the hardest. But I don't quite know what to say to them.", ' And what about you? Will time heal your wounds?', " Kotallo more than most. If I were this Regalla, I wouldn't want to cross him on the battlefield.", " That's where you come in, I suspect.", ' Did she say why?', " But you still don't trust her. Where I come from the more valuable the knowledge shared, the higher the price extracted. I'd be careful if I were you, Aloy.", " A flood control system back in the Great Delta. It was built by Eileen Sasaki, another of our ancestors. If we can acquire the data on it, we might be able to fix the system back home. Then my sister, my parents, other families - won't have to live in fear of their homes washing away when the long rains come.", " I won't let you down.", ' Thank you, Aloy.', " (via Focus) I'll be there as soon as I can.", ' (panting) Aloy! I’m here. Had to sneak past a few machines on the way, but I made it.', " Yes. He's right over there.", " Were looking for the Atbay Research Center where Leviathan was developed. The Legacy tells us it's somewhere in the city.", " You're hiding something.", " Oh, you're worried you found something dangerous. Something compromising on Eileen Sasaki?", " Look. I get it. Nirik. You want to make it back to your family, so it's safer to turn a blind eye. But think of Leviathan. How it could help everyone. Isn't that why we're here? Don't let fear deny us that.", " Too often the truth is forbidden. (to Aloy) Come on. Let's go.", " Nirik's like I used to be. Terrified of a misstep. And with the Overseers, he has every right to be. But what I've seen and learned since the Greenhouse… it's so much more than what we're permitted. Diviners are supposed to seek the truth and yet so much is kept from us. I'm tired of it. That should be the facility ahead. Hmm. We need to find a way in.", ' Uh, Aloy. Why is the ground shaking?', ' Whoa that thing is huge!', " Uh… okay! I'm with you.", " Phew! Well, I'm gonna have nightmares tonight.", ' Hmm. Lot of sand, not a lot of data.', ' After you.', " At least the water's not freezing. Look at this place. I always try to imagine what it must've been like, back when the Old Ones were here.", ' On every expeditions the soldiers would lay down walkways and barriers fist. To protect us Diviners. But this is actually kind of fun.', " Must've been what Ninik found.", " That was her. The Ancestor, Eileen Sasaki. Hundreds dead and she knew their system was to blame, but she had the truth erased. Were all the Ancestors like this? Selfish, ruthless, amoral? And yet we hold them up as paragons of enlightenment and virtue. Given what we've learned, I don't even know if Leviathan will work.", ' To their corporate headquarters… There.', " Let's go. It shouldn't take us long to get to the tower.", ' The Legacy tells us it was the predecessor to Leviathan. A system that manipulated foods to bring life to a barren desert.', ' Diviners spent years trying to figure out how to restore Leviathan. We found a lot of data on Eileen Sasaki in the process. Though now I wonder how much of it is actually true.', ' The soldiers built a path on the nearby ruin. Might be able to cross over from there.', ' I think this is as far as our soldiers got.', " I'll follow your lead. Up we go.", " Yes! Don't worry about me. How are we going to get across?", ' Or we could sneak by. And, you know, not fall off the tower.', " Uh... Aloy? We're really high off the ground.", ' Right. (fake laugh) Of course. Super easy.', ' Aloy!', ' Right. Yeah.', ' Aloy, can you watch me and make sure I do this right?', ' AHHH!', " I'm okay! (laughs) Wow, that would've been a long way to fall.", ' According to the Legacy, it was October 2023.', " Doesn't matter. She still had a part in it.", " Dead end. There's a ladder in that shaft, but it's blocked.", " Uh, you go on ahead. I'll look for a way up that has a lesser chance of falling to my death.", ' Yes?', " I'm not sure. The Legacy doesn't say. Either that knowledge is Lost or Forbidden… Or maybe we were wrong about that too. Are you doing okay, Aloy?", ' Not yet.', ' Whoa! Oh, I can reach the ladder now. Be right up, Aloy!', " Okay, I'll meet you up there.", " Made it! These artifacts... I think these were Eileen's. It's every Diviner's dream to discover even one of the Ancestor's artifacts.", " Could it be… yes, I think this was commissioned in honor of the company's 25th anniversary. Oh, that must be the Larsen-McCorry Award. The Legacy says Eileen won it when she was 40... for her work on Leviathan.", ' That must be the Dragonfly-6. Atbay used it in most of their construction projects.', ' For water purification. Must be the H2Flow.', ' H2Flow. Their early inventions had strange names.', " It's worth a try.", " Corner office, impressive view… it must've been Eileen's.", ' She overthrew her father, took over the company… so that Leviathan wouldn’t end up killing people.', " She wasn't perfect. Not a paragon, as the Quen believe… But not a monster either. She tried to make up for her mistakes.", " As for the data… Leviathan... yes. It's here. Downloading a copy now.", " I think I'll stay here a while longer. There's a lot more data that I want to look through.", " Down is always easier than up. Let's speak again when we're back at base.", " You're going to what?", " Aloy! Do you have a moment? You… you flew! Kotallo told me! And took out Regalla's machines! You know what? I don't even know why I'm surprised. I saw we have visitors. And a new weapon. Does this mean we're ready to take the fight to the Zeniths?", " Oh! And I wanted to give you this. For helping me get the data on Leviathan. I didn't really know what to give you, so I asked Zo what you might like.", " I've already braved oceans and madmen who thought they were Ancestors reborn. Why not a few immortals with lethal drones at their command, too?", " I almost went up to her. To ask her, well, every question I've ever had about the Legacy. Every Diviner I know would kill to get five minutes with one of the Old Ones. But now that she's here, all I feel is a vague unease. I don't know if I'm scared of finding out more uncomfortable truths, or just scared of her. Probably both.", " This Sylens. He's the one who built the weapon that can take down Zenith shields?", ' Oh.', ' Our… spirit?', " There is much to sort through still, but I believe we'll be able to get it operational and turn back the floods. And I've given more thought to everything we've uncovered about the Ancestors. The Overseers would have us believe they were infallible paragons. But Faro wasn't, not even close. His greed led to machines that devoured the world. The archive of the Old Ones' knowledge destroyed, just to erase his mistakes. So, when we learned that Eileen had a hand in covering up hundreds of deaths… I started to think they were all the same. Selfish, egotistical, cruel. But in the end… it's not that simple. The truth isn't a straight line of ink on a crisp scroll. It's a splatter, smudged and faded on stained parchment. Or twisting the truth to serve their own schemes.", " No, nor the rest of the Board of Overseers. As Eileen said - it's easier to believe the lie is truth. But it's worth fighting for. But it's worth fighting for. And this Diviner, at least, won't settle for anything less. For that I thank you, Aloy.", " Kotallo showed me the schematics for his new arm. I recall reading about robotic limbs within the Legacy, but I never thought I'd see one in action. Technology like that would be treasured back home. Think of what it could do for injured workers or soldiers! But knowing the Imperial Family, they would use it for different purposes. Their own.", ' Exactly.', " I'll be ready when you call.", ' How?', ' All right. But, why? What I am trying to do?', " I'll do my best.", " I'd be lying if I said I'm not slightly apprehensive.", ' Right.', " I don't know. The more I think about it the more worried I become, if I go back I don't even know if they'd let me keep this Focus you gave me. Or what they'd do to me for reading what is clearly Forbidden data. Even if somehow were allowed to carry on my duties as a Diviner… Would I be willing to let the truths I've learned about the Ancestors be buried away by the Board of Overseers? Would I dare challenge them and risk my family's safety? Or losing Federa.", ' What exactly do you expect me to find, Aloy?', " She… is another Diviner. One of our best. We used to be rivals at the Academy. I hated her guts. But apparently there's a fine line between hate and love. We became very close And then I was assigned to the expedition. She promised she'd wait for me. No matter how long it took.", " I don't know about that.", " Whatever happens, I'm grateful that the Legacy brought us together. I never thought I'd get to actually meet an Ancestor.", " I'm not afraid. I know Kotallo will fulfill his duty, as will. If we die doing so, at least it'll be alongside a friend.", " We'll try and keep that in mind.", " I'll be at the rendezvous point. May truth lead us to victory.", ' I wish there was a less… pungent way to get way inside the base.', " (via Focus) Aloy. It's been… intense But Kotallo got me to a network node. I'm trying to get in.", " (via Focus) I'm almost into the network!", ' (via Focus) Aloy, you there? Listen - I got into the network, but only for a minute before I was shut out. I found a bunch of flight plans and trajectories. As if the Zeniths were planning to leave Earth.', ' (via Focus) I know! But there\'s more. The files I found have a lot of references to something called "nemesis." Whatever it is. the Zeniths are afraid of it.', ' She looks okay!', " I'd be fine with a nap."]

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [' Ha! Over here you filatning hunk of scrap!', ' Got you! Talanah?', ' Hit it with freeze ammo! Hit it with ice! Lure it into the traps! Freeze it!', " I was going to send the message right after I crossed into the desert with an Oseram caravan. But when it became clear that the tunnel had  collapsed behind us. I figured the only thing I could do was press on. Seeing as you found a way out here, however... clearly I was wrong. I'm sorry. The last thing I wanted was to worry you.", " And you must be Aloy. Talanah's told me a lot about you. And I guess you must know about me.", " A clue... or a shred of one. Anything about Nessa's fate. Maybe she died on the battlefield. Or maybe she wasted away in that prison. Either way. I have to know.", ' We were both assigned to the Southern Spear division. Our orders were to push into Tenakth territory through the tunnel. She was proud to serve the Sundom, at first. But as the atrocities mounted we both saw the Raids for what they were.', ' We did what we could to protect innocent lives. It felt like we were the only ones who objected to the slaughter. And... yes, we were close. Until the Battle of the Burning Blooms.', ' I had intel that the Tenakth forces were greater than we had anticipated. I tried to convince my commander to halt the attack. He was a drunken lout. And when I threatened to reveal his incompetence to Carja High Command, he pulled a knife on me. So I killed him.', " It was still murder. I was condemned. But I thought at least I could still save Nessa. I was too late. By the time I got to the battle, the fields were already burning, our soldiers slaughtered or missing. What's more, the commander I had killed was from a powerful noble house. They put a bounty on my head. I've been on the run ever since.", " The Sun-King can't help me.", ' Clawstriders, a hunter-killer mercenaries a Shellsnapper... nothing could get in her way.', ' That was foolish of him, in hindsight.', " I can't ask you to come with me. I feel bad enough you've come this far.", " I know better than to try to talk you out of it. Come, then. The Rot's not far.", " The Rot’s along the shore, but we'll have to stick to the woods to avoid being seen.", ' I overheard a Tenakth patrol from the nearby village talking about it. Figured it out from there.', " only need to question one guard. Figured I'd grab someone when they were by themselves.", " We're getting close. Just a little further.", ' There it is. The Rot.', " Then they would've killed any of the guards. They were my last hope of finding out if Nessa was there.", ' Even after all this time?', " Then let's do it. Any scrap of hope is better than nothing.", ' We’ll stay here.', ' Hear that?', " I'm looking for information about a Carja soldier. She might've been a prisoner here five years back. Her name was Nessa.", ' Nessa?', " Ness-- Ritakka. I've mourned you for five years. Why didn't you let me know you were alive?", " I didn't abandon you. Before the battle, I tried to get Gediah to call off the attack, but of course he didn't listen. I ended up killing him.", ' I ran for the battlefield to find you. But you were already gone by the time I got there.', ' I would’ve, had I known.', " So this is it? After everything we've been through... this is goodbye?", " Somehow it hurts worse. You must think I'm an idiot.", " Talanah, I... understand. I'm sorry it came to this."]

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [' If we look into the future through the lens of the recent past, our fears loom. Wars waged against machines. Starcity of food and water. Storms that drive us from our homes. But true courage means facing those fears with conviction instead of cynicism. Leading the peacekeeping effort with these brave men and women, these "Marshals" of the new southwest… …has strengthened my conviction that when we are united, we can overcome any threat. Join me - join us - in that conviction, as we strive for a nation and a world without want or war.']

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [" That damned mine is what happened to me… Won't be the last injury if Ulvund keeps shoving his tongs into those tunnels.", " Yeah, couple of days ago. That's how I hurt this blasted leg. Korvend and the others were opening a new vein while I was checking on an older one. As soon as their blast hit, the tunnel I was in collapsed. Might have dodged it if I wasn't running on barely a spark of sleep. We were pushing too hard and too fast.", ' Mm-hmm. Hit the nail right on the head.', ' Try telling Ulvund that. He brought in all the backing to get them open, might as well own them. Fire and spit… you ask him, he owns us as well.', " He's our foreman, and a damn good one. The kind that knows how to deal with management when it gets unreasonable. But Ulvund… his demands go beyond unreasonable. Korvend's been doing his best to appease him… He even blamed himself for my injury when it was Ulvund who ordered the extra shifts.", " That's why we all put up with the long hours and lousy conditions… But if the whole mine becomes unstable… I'd rather suffer Ulvund's wrath than die buried in rubble.", ' I… would appreciate that. Thank you.']

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [" Not a chance. He's a traitor.", " So you've enlisted the Chief's Champion in your dull-bladed efforts.", ' Or trying to lure us into a trap. My scouts caught him sneaking around on the outskirts of the village.', " The only thing you'll do is face trial by combat. You betrayed your clan, your Chief. Blood and blades will decide your fate.", " And Hekarro was a Lowlander before he was Chief. Unlike the Desert and Sky Clans, we've always stood behind him without question. Fall's Edge is a strategic midpoint between the Grove and our capital on the coast.", " Don't believe his lies. Anyone who deserted the tribe to join Regalla knew exactly what they were getting themselves into.", " No. I won't give him the chance to escape. The traitor stays here until his trial by combat.", " You're making a mistake, Chaplain. The dan needs your guidance, not the lies of this bare-armed boy.", " Then I'm going too. If the boy speaks truth, you'll need my blade. If he lies, I'll run him through. I must make arrangements here, first. Then I'll bring the boy to the meeting place.", ' What did I tell you? His lies are an open sore. Better we cauterize it now than let it fester.', ' As you say. But this is a mistake.', ' (to Kevvoh) Lead the way.', " Or they are and we'll be skewered the moment we arrive.", " And there's no one there. As I suspected.", " I don't like this.", " Blood of the Ten. If that thing runs through Fall's Edge, the village stands no chance.", ' Because of your warning. You saved many lives today.', " Go on ahead. I'll see him back to the village.", " Regrets that he doubted the boy. Your grandson proved himself to be honest and brave, Chaplain. He's loyal to the Lowland.", " He's earned his freedom. But it'll take many more deeds to earn back the rest of the clans trust.", " Indeed. Fall's Edge owes you a great debt. May this begin to repay it."]

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [' Her machines took out my entire squad!']

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [" It's true - we bear gifts.", " Decorum usually calls for a ceremony of offering at the palace, but I thought you'd prefer a less formal occasion. Bring them, please.", ' On behalf of all the citizens of the Sundom, may these tokens remind you of our eternal gratitude.', " The sculptor wanted something even bigger - twice the size, covered in gold and jewels. But I was quite certain you wouldn't appreciate that.", " I see. I had hoped you'd remain in the city for a time perhaps at the Palace.", ' By the Sun, the Tenakth? Well. Perhaps Marad already told you, but after years of hostility. Another embassy will be held in just a day or two.', ' Ah, yes. My favorite subject.', ' As you know, my father raided all the border tribes. The Oseram, Banuk, and Nora suffered greatly resisting as best they could. But none fought back like the Tenakth. They rose up and assaulted our western front at Barren Light sweeping us from their lands. Getting them to talk to us again after that was tricky.', " Just like today, it is special because of the guest. Our delegation will meet with the Tenakth just outside Barren Light. Well give them treasure… …and they'll return a prisoner - Fashav, one of our finest soldiers.", ' No, not in this case. Fashav is my cousin nothing like Helis and his ilk. He joined the western expedition with the hopes of reining in certain… excesses. But he was captured during a heroic defense of our forward base at Cinnabar Sands, and has been held ever since.', ' Five years. Tenakth emissaries swear he is well, but I wonder. That tribe is renowned for its brutality. How did he survive? Well know soon enough. If you see him before I do, tell him that Tawalt him in Meridian where he belongs.', ' The same way I got you to talk. By giving gifts.', " More like metals, spices, and relics looted during the fighting. We've met with them on several occasions, and the gifts seem to have eased the tension. But this coming Embassy is the most important yet the best sign we've had so far that the Tenakth want lasting peace.", " You got him out of Sunfall. Any happiness he has, he owes to you. He stumped into a fine young man. Which he'll need to be if he's to inherit the crown.", " Yes, well, I'd have to get married for that to happen.", " Marad keeps throwing noble matches at me… …but I find I'm always trying to make them into someone they're not. (Aloy smiles) At any rate, I never aspired to the throne and I don't wish to sit there forever. When Itamen comes of age I hope to step aside. Free of the crown. I might finally be able to travel the world. Who knows? Perhaps even accompany you on one of your adventures.", " One moment, Aloy… there's something I must ask you. Since you left I've thought of little else.", " But it has to be. The way you left before… there's no way to know when I'll see you again. I'm not trying to stop you. or hold you back. But I need to know… When your mission is over, will you return to Meridian? And stay? Long enough for us to… spend time to… get to know each other properly, perhaps?", " You're right. I'm acting like a fool. It's supposed to be the king who calls for higher perspective. Please accept my apology - and my wishes for your success. Goodbye, Aloy. As always, our hopes ride with you.", ' May the Sun bless your path.']

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [" That's it. Smash 'em to scrap!", ' Those acid-spitters brought friends.', " That's it. Smash ‘em to scrap!", ' Ha ha! Look at that thing drop!', " Stranger, come on over here. We gotta talk. Over here girl. I wanna thank you. I dunno what a Nora is doin' out here, but consider yourself owed. We tried to hold off and wait for the Vanguard, but one of them Bristlebacks charged us. Next thing you know, it was a full-fledged fracas!", " We lost some good people. But we would've lost the whole quarry without you.", " Your ears oughta be ringin’ with a quarry at work! But Chainscrape's whistle ain't blowin’, so we're stuck pickin' up the pieces.", " Me and my crew, we're just little cogs out here. Can't lift a hammer till Ulvund blows that thing. 'Cause if we work without his say-so, he'll ban us. And my people have been through enough.", " He's got the money and connections to snuff our fires for good. Almost feels like we stood a better chance with the Bristlebacks.", " We're supposed to be working Ulvund's claim, diggin' out stone to shore up Barren Light. But the work stoppage and the Bristlebacks cut us short. Never seen those blasted things in the Daunt before. Where in forge fire did they come from?", ' Thanks to you, that might actually be possible today.']

Title: Horizon Forbidden West
Dialogues: [' Has someone…?', " Hello, Elisabet - apologies, I don't know what else to call you. Um. My name is Beta. I'm afraid I must be brief. I only have a few minutes before my keepers discover I'm missing, and I still need to remove this implant. I had hoped to find shelter with you, but if you're viewing this, I may be dead. Be careful when you take on Far Zenith. They are ruthless, and they have ELEUTHIA, ARTEMIS, and APOLLO now. But at least they don't have the GAIA kernel to merge them with.", ' You must succeed or this was all for nothing. Good luck... and goodbye.', ' Sudden removal of a neurologically-integrated data device. The brain, especially the cerebellum, goes into a kind of sensory free-fall. Everything real feels... unreal. Distant.', " Do you have a Focus to spare? It's primitive... but I can make it work.", ' Booting up. Ahhh. So... Aloy. I suppose you want information.', " That seems consistent with their behavior. They wouldn't want to be followed.", " Yes for a few hundred years. But it didn't last. Some sort of natural disaster rendered it uninhabitable.", ' Not their descendants.', " Not their descendants. It's them. The same ones who left Earth a thousand years ago. You didn't know?", ' I believe it’s a combination of pharmaceuticals, cellular treatments, and technological implants.', " I'm not like them. I was made on the way to Earth. On the ship. I spent years studying in my training interface. All so that I could serve my function.", " When I discovered the Zero Dawn system had disseminated into its sub-components, I thought my purpose was to fix it. But I don't think the Zeniths want that at all. I think they want to wipe Earth clean and start over.", " When they took me on missions with them, I saw how they butchered the tribal people we encountered. They didn't seem to care about a rejuvenated Earth. So, I concluded that they must want a hard reboot of the system. Then they can redesign it to be exactly what they want.", " They told me I was born to interface with the Zero Dawn system. When we reached Earth, I pieced together what must have happened to GAIA and her subordinate functions. That's when I started to realize I wasn't meant to fix GAIA. That they must've made me so I could do what their remote Extinction Signal failed to do - reboot Earth for their own benefit.", ' It was speculation but the only logical conclusion why GAIA suddenly self-destructed after operating efficiently for centuries. GAIA would have only undertaken such a desperate course of action if it had detected a threat to life on Earth… that was more dangerous than ceasing function altogether. I should have realized that she would also order the recreation of Elisabet Sobeck to rebuild her.', " They were some of the most affluent and powerful people on Earth. They controlled almost every major resource, every industry. Gerard commands them. He's the one who decided to set up a base. The others - Erik, Tilda, Verbena - they resent his authority over them, but in the end, they always do what he says.", ' He enjoys hurting people.', ' Off the coast, I think. Whenever I had to go on missions, I was transported inside of a Specter drone. I couldn\'t see anything outside. But I did overhear the Zeniths talking about it once. They were discussing setting up a perimeter energy shield to… "repel the local fauna." I\'m certain they have other security measures - Specter patrols, machine lures. It must be impregnable.', ' Launch facilities so they can shuttle back and forth to their ship. in orbit. Plus infrastructure to gather materials and fabricate anything they need.', " I'm not sure. I suppose there must be more of them in the base or back on the ship. For all know, there could also be more of them out in space. Other survivors of the colony.", " All I was ever told was that a natural disaster forced them to leave Sirius. I've speculated that it was an extrasolar object, or a cataclysmic seismic event… ...or maybe even an abnormally violent coronal mass ejection from Sirius A.", ' They said the only thing that mattered was that they survived. First Earth, a thousand years ago, and then Sirius.', " Before the HADES Proving Lab, I never thought I'd get away from them. Even if I were to run, I'd never survive on my own in the wilds. But then I saw you. And I thought that maybe you could help me. But then I saw you. And though. So when the Zeniths pinpointed ELEUTHIA's location in the biomedical research facility, I saw an opportunity.", ' Whenever I was taken out on a mission to recover a subordinate function, only one of the Zeniths would go with me.', " Verbena's dead? How did they bypass her shield?", " Well, when it was time to use the Zeniths' transmitter to send ELEUTHIA back to base. I also sent the encrypted transmission. Then I distracted Verbena long enough to seal myself in the ectogenic chamber… ...altering the facility's logs so it appeared that there were only 236 containers.", ' I told them I could capture ELEUTHIA faster if I had it with me, and they believed me.', " The Zeniths had an ectogenic chamber aboard the ship, an updated version of the one you found me in. They must have used a stored sample of Elisabet's DNA.", " That wasn't part of the archive I was allowed to access.", ' But only the parts I was permitted to access. Aristotle and Aspasia the avatars of the archive - would assign me learning modules and evaluate my progress.', ' The Zeniths have a copy.', ' Only what was deemed pertinent to the mission. If I requested information outside of my parameters, my tutors would deny it.', " So how long? You know… your plan.
